title: Corporate Entity & Regulatory Setup
description: Statutory steps required under Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA), RBI Foreign Exchange Management Act (FEMA), and direct taxation.

items.title: Reserve Corporate Entity Name
items.description: Apply for corporate name reservation via MCA SPICe+ portal ensuring compliance with Rule 8 of Companies (Incorporation) Rules.

items.title: Procure Class-3 DSC & DIN for Directors
items.description: Obtain Class 3 Digital Signature Certificates and DINs for proposed India resident and non-resident directors.

items.title: Submit Articles of Association & Memorandum
items.description: Integrated filing for Certificate of Incorporation (CoI), PAN, TAN, EPFO, ESIC, and Profession Tax registration in a single submission.

items.title: Foreign Inward Remittance & RBI Equity Allocation
items.description: Inject paid-up foreign capital into Indian authorized dealer bank; submit Form FC-GPR to the Reserve Bank of India via FIRMS portal within 30 days.

items.title: Goods and Services Tax & Inter-Company Master Agreement
items.description: Register for state GST; establish arm's length inter-company service agreement (typically Cost Plus 12-18% under safe harbor guidelines).

title: Real Estate & Campus Selection
description: From search to lease execution, power connectivity, and turnkey workplace fit-outs.

items.title: Target Cluster Identification
items.description: Evaluate micro-markets based on talent commute radius, metro transit accessibility, and power redundancy (e.g. ORR Bengaluru vs Financial District Hyderabad).

items.title: Commercial Developer RFP & Legal Verification
items.description: Issue RFP to Grade A institutional tech park developers (Embassy, RMZ, Brookfield, Mindspace); perform title search and occupancy certificate (OC) checks.

items.title: Execute Lease Deed & Obtain Fit-out Clearances
items.description: Execute registered lease deed, remit applicable stamp duty (utilizing state policy exemptions if applicable), and secure municipal fire NOC and environmental clearance.

items.title: Workplace Fit-out, Data Labs, and Dual UPS Power
items.description: Construct workstations, acoustic conference suites, server rooms with dual UPS backup and precision air conditioning.

title: Talent Acquisition & People Operations
description: Leadership recruitment, employer branding, compensation bands, and employment law compliances.

items.step: 1. Appoint India Managing Director / Center Head
items.title: Anchor Leadership Executive Search
items.description: Recruit senior GCC leader with proven track record in standing up capability centres and establishing local credibility with global stakeholders.

items.title: Benchmarking Salary & Equity Incentive Plans
items.description: Calibrate compensation against local peers (accounting for the 15-22% GCC premium) and configure cross-border stock option (RSU/ESOP) compliance under Indian tax law.

items.title: Initial 25-50 Senior Engineers & Principal Architects
items.description: Execute specialized lateral recruiting sprints for core engineering teams before initiating campus or high-volume hiring.

items.title: POSH Committee, Gratuity Trust & Standing Orders
items.description: Form Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH) internal committee, configure statutory Gratuity trust, and establish local employment contracts.

title: Provider Ecosystem & Vendor Selection
description: Contracting specialized service providers across real estate, legal, audit, payroll, and facility management.

items.title: Retain Tier-1 Indian Law Firm
items.description: Engage counsel for day-to-day statutory advisory, board minutes, foreign exchange filings, and labor dispute representation.

items.title: Appoint Statutory Auditors
items.description: Select accredited audit firm (under Companies Act Section 139) and transfer pricing advisory partner.

items.title: Select Payroll Engine & Group Health Insurance Provider
items.description: Deploy local payroll engine (handling TDS, PF, ESI deductions) and procure corporate group medical insurance (minimum ₹5-10 Lakh family cover standard).
items.timeline: 2 to 4 weeks prior to first hire

items.title: Physical Security, Transport & Pantry Operations
items.description: Contract accredited Integrated Facility Management (IFM) partner with 24/7 security guard force and employee transport logistics.
